summary: Master the intricacies of Applied IFRS Valuation for properties and financial instruments. Join our comprehensive training course and elevate your skills today!
lede: IFRS valuation covers how to measure property and financial instruments for financial reporting. This applied course is for finance, accounting, audit, treasury, risk, property and public-sector professionals who prepare, review or support IFRS valuations. It develops practical skills in selecting fair-value approaches and inputs, assessing impairment and expected credit losses, and documenting assumptions and explaining valuation conclusions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are directly or indirectly responsible for valuing assets and financial instruments under IFRS.
modules: Valuation of Property, Plant, and Equipment (IAS 16)
Valuation of Financial Instruments under IFRS 9
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of IFRS standards and experience in financial reporting or asset management.
